div.p: Note. Paper filtering was performed using a custom Python script ("apply_filter.py", in "slr/searches/filter"), configured via a "config.json" file. Filtering was based on three criteria: (1) a keyword list, (2) an exclude-keyword list (which takes precedence over the keyword list), (3) and a must-keep list of papers retained regardless of the other two
